title: GL-10 — Queue and event path
stopChargesPanel: Delete the function, log group, queue, and topic (deleting the topic also deletes its subscriptions), then the IAM role.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on SQS, SNS, and Lambda; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Set lab variables
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.
Success: date variables and lab names are set.

steps.title: Create Lambda execution role
bullets: Save gl10-trust.json for lambda.amazonaws.com.

Run `$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl10-trust.json", '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"lambda.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}', $utf8)`.

Run `aws iam create-role --role-name workbook-gl10-lambda --assume-role-policy-document file://gl10-trust.json --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-10 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt`
Run `aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name workbook-gl10-lambda --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole`.
Run `$LambdaRoleArn = aws iam get-role --role-name workbook-gl10-lambda --query Role.Arn --output text`.
Success: role Arn is set.

steps.title: Create SNS topic and SQS queue
bullets: Run `$TopicArn = aws sns create-topic --name workbook-gl10 --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-10 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt --query TopicArn --output text`.
Run `$QueueUrl = aws sqs create-queue --queue-name workbook-gl10 --attributes MessageRetentionPeriod=86400 --tags LabId=gl-10,Workbook=aws-tf-lab --query QueueUrl --output text`.
Run `$QueueArn = aws sqs get-queue-attributes --queue-url $QueueUrl --attribute-names QueueArn --query Attributes.QueueArn --output text`.
Success: topic and queue Arns are set.

steps.title: Subscribe SQS to SNS
bullets: Run `aws sns subscribe --topic-arn $TopicArn --protocol sqs --notification-endpoint $QueueArn`.
Save queue policy allowing SNS to sqs:SendMessage.

Run `$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; $Gl10QueuePolicy = @{ Version = '2012-10-17'; Statement = @(@{ Sid = 'AllowSnsSendMessage'; Effect = 'Allow'; Principal = @{ Service = 'sns.amazonaws.com' }; Action = 'sqs:SendMessage'; Resource = $QueueArn; Condition = @{ ArnEquals = @{ 'aws:SourceArn' = $TopicArn } } }) }; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl10-queue-policy.json", ($Gl10QueuePolicy | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress), $utf8)`.
Run `aws sqs set-queue-attributes --queue-url $QueueUrl --attributes Policy=file://gl10-queue-policy.json`.
Success: subscription is confirmed.

steps.title: Create Lambda function
bullets: Run `$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\lambda_function.py", "import json`n`ndef lambda_handler(event, context):`n    records = event.get('Records', [])`n    for record in records:`n        message = record.get('Sns', {}).get('Message', '')`n        print('Received SNS message: ' + str(message))`n    return {'recordCount': len(records)}`n", $utf8); Compress-Archive -Path lambda_function.py -DestinationPath function.zip -Force`. This writes a handler that reads the SNS records this lab's subscription delivers, logs each message, and returns a record count, with LF endings and no BOM, then zips it to function.zip.

Run `$FunctionArn = aws lambda create-function --function-name workbook-gl10 --runtime python3.12 --role $LambdaRoleArn --handler lambda_function.lambda_handler --zip-file fileb://function.zip --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-10 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt --query FunctionArn --output text`.
Success: function is Active.

steps.title: Wire SNS to Lambda
bullets: Run `aws sns subscribe --topic-arn $TopicArn --protocol lambda --notification-endpoint $FunctionArn`.
Run `aws lambda add-permission --function-name workbook-gl10 --statement-id sns-gl10 --action lambda:InvokeFunction --principal sns.amazonaws.com --source-arn $TopicArn`.
Success: subscription exists.

steps.title: Publish test message
bullets: Run `aws sns publish --topic-arn $TopicArn --message '{"test":"gl10"}'`.
Run `aws logs tail /aws/lambda/workbook-gl10 --since 5m` after a short wait.
Success: log shows the invocation.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
SNS, SQS, and Lambda all bill per request (each has its own monthly free tier), and CloudWatch Logs bills per GB stored. Nothing in this lab is hourly, and there is no instance to stop.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: Lambda, log group, queue, topic (delete-topic also deletes its SNS subscriptions), IAM role
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-10` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-10 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-10 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-10. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Wire SNS to SQS and Lambda without VPC. Publish one message and confirm Lambda execution logs.
